spans.quotation: The full board regularly reviews company actions and seeks external perspectives on a range of sustainability issues, including environmental, health and safety (EHS) performance; climate-related risks and opportunities, greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and water usage; human capital management and succession planning; diversity and inclusion (D&I); and cybersecurity.

The CRG&N Committee oversees the company's efforts on ESG issues. This committee's annual calendar includes designated meetings for in-depth discussions on various topics, including governance trends that impact the company and the energy industry, approval of political contributions and lobbying expenditures using company funds, monitoring of human rights, and review of this report.

We underpin this alignment by linking 20% of all executives' and employees' annual incentive compensation directly to ESG- and safety-performance-related goals. Beginning in 2022, our compensation-linked ESG goals have included both short- and long-term targets. We review and update our compensation goals annually to drive ongoing performance improvement. In past years, our goals have included initiatives to reduce emissions, increase the use of recycled water and expand D&I efforts across the company. For 2023, our compensation goals included reducing methane emissions by converting more than 2,000 pneumatic devices to instrument air or through valve retrofit; achieving a Severe Incident Rate at or below 0.028; and utilizing at least 50% recycled produced water for completions in U.S. onshore operations. All three goals were achieved in 2023.

note: criteria 1,2,4,5 — 4 of 5. Criterion 2 (target-bound): compensation-linked ESG goals with named short- and long-term targets anchored to 2023 performance cycle satisfy this criterion; targets are sustainability/emissions goals overseen at board level. Criterion 3 (methodology): not satisfied per handbook v1.3 rule — governance oversight descriptions and committee structures do not constitute measurement or calculation methodology; methodology_disclosed = false enforced. Criterion 4 (time horizon): CRG&N annual calendar cadence and 'at every meeting' / 'at least annually' reporting cadence from Board ESG Framework diagram (p. 25) establish a stated time horizon; short- and long-term target references on p. 26 reinforce this. Criterion 5 (progress tracking): multi-year narrative from 2022 onward with 2023 goal achievement confirmation constitutes progress tracking against board-overseen ESG targets across periods.
